lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately 10-12 distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. These nodes form a semi-regular grid where vertical spacing between centroids is approximately 1.5x the horizontal spacing between columns in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity run dorso-ventrally across the flank. High-intensity circular blobs are positioned as anchor nodes at the intersection of these vertical bands and faint horizontal lines, most prominent in the central longitudinal axis.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible. The primary ridge originates posterior to the dorsal gill margin, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a dark shadow-cast on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs on its distal half. The proximal-posterior region of the fin features a unique, non-circular 'whorl' or 'U-shaped' pattern of elevated pixel intensity.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique 'whorl' or concentric pixel arrangement is located on the posterior-central surface of the first dorsal fin, distinct from the standard circular blob morphology.
